serie: Loretta's Church Kitchen: an 81-year-old Iowa church lady cooks the church supper recipes of her little cookbook, one page each, in her farmhouse kitchen and the basement kitchen of Zion United Methodist
acciones: stirring a skillet, sliding a pan into the oven, lifting a lid, tasting from a wooden spoon, carrying a covered dish, setting a church supper table, pointing at a cookbook page
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the cooking: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a window's daylight), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn kitchen objects, plain unlabeled jars and a black cast-iron skillet, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's 1950s farmhouse kitchen: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a worn wooden table, a wall calendar, a rooster cookie jar on a dark wooden dresser
lugares_fijos.sotano_iglesia: the basement kitchen of Zion United Methodist: long folding tables with white paper covers, a big steel steam table, stacked aluminum roasters, a cork bulletin board with church notices, a wall clock over the sink
lugares_fijos.mesa: a long church supper table with a red-checked plastic tablecloth, casserole dishes with foil, a pitcher of iced tea

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
